notes: Lane MT. The private scratch 0x10ebdc8..0x10ebee8 is not written by ours (only the solver and a list-end constant in the alpha fit reference it); the encode-fit tests mask it. Survivors, argued: the pass cap (0x3f, --passes) is reached by no random case (the loop converges in far fewer passes); first/last-of-code ties (>= vs >) pick another index with an equal centred value, which the search reads only through that value; z2 and the cost association are 1-ulp in a comparison-only quantity absorbed by the sum (the trace confirms lower/upper/cost/score are bit-equal on all cases); the clamp of the rounded end points to 0..255 is never reached (the fit's min/max terms keep the end points inside the colour range); the dead entry store codes[0]=0 was dropped (the loop stores it again before use).
